meta.title: 0rbital — Co-living Founder Programs
meta.scope: Co-living founder programs only: founder residencies and hacker/founder houses where people live and build together for a fixed term. Every record is a live-in / residential cohort (canonicalType founder-residency or hacker-house, or format live-in). Categorized by the canonical program taxonomy (see src/data/taxonomy.ts).
meta.note: Recruiting status reflects best-available public info as of June 2026 and changes frequently. Always confirm on the program's own site. Logos are self-hosted (collected by scripts/fetch-logos.ts into public/logos/, indexed by src/lib/logoManifest.json) and served local-first, falling back to live DuckDuckGo → Google favicon services and finally an initials placeholder. Every program domain has a logo: programs whose site publishes none get a generated SVG monogram so no marker is blank.

status_legend.open: Applications are open (rolling or a current cohort window)
status_legend.closed: Applications closed; check the site for the next cycle

programs.status_detail: 12-week live-in residency, ~10 founders. Up to $1M uncapped SAFE for 5%.

programs.name: The Bridge (by Entrepreneurs First)
programs.focus: Pre-team/pre-idea founders; cofounder matching → company building

programs.highlight: EF's relocation residency — cofounder matching that moves into an SF hacker house for 8 weeks.

programs.name: Pluto (AI Hacker House)
programs.status_detail: Roving AI/robotics builder residency (most recent cohort: Munich; also Zurich/Paris). Active on LinkedIn.
programs.highlight: Roving live-in residency for AI/robotics builders.
